claims: Aday Mara is the starting #15 center for the 2025-26 Michigan Wolverines basketball team.
Aday Mara is a junior transfer from Spain.
Aday Mara averages 2.6 blocks per game.
Aday Mara was named the Big Ten Defensive Player of the Year.
Aday Mara's hometown is Zaragoza, Spain.
Aday Mara's 2025-26 stats are approx. 10–12 points, 7 rebounds, and 2.6 blocks per game.
Aday Mara joined Michigan after playing for the UCLA Bruins.
